verdict.rationale: Vast.ai's own CLI walkthrough includes a 'copy data' step as part of the instance workflow, and its SSH docs describe transferring files. That is first-party transfer tooling, but only thinly evidenced. Persistent volumes exist but are storage, not transfer, and community reports of inconsistent instance bandwidth temper the 'efficiently' claim without contradicting the documented tooling. missing for 10: S3-compatible endpoints, cloud-storage sync integrations (S3/GCS/etc.), in-depth documentation of the copy/transfer commands, independent corroboration of transfer performance.
